welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: OpenHotel Setup Wizard!
welcome.description: Complete this wizard to get your hotel running. It only takes a few minutes.

code.title: Setup code
code.hint: The server prints a one-time code in its log when it starts empty. This keeps strangers from setting up your server first.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Choose your hotel default language. Guests can pick their own from the available ones.

managed.title: Managed
managed.hint: Joins an existing network such as openhotel.club. You get a license from the network and guests use their network account.

standalone.title: Standalone
standalone.hint: One hotel on its own, with its own accounts. No network, no license.

network.title: Network
network.hint: You run the network: accounts, hotels, licenses and news. Your first hotel is part of it.
